title: a FIFO and a LIFO called in a loop leave the evaluation stack as they found it
note: Not an IEC block, and a stack contract: a call of a block takes nothing from the evaluation stack and leaves nothing on it, so a loop of 40 calls loads (RT-003); every odd i is a rising edge of PUSH, so each block fills its eight items and ignores the rest, and the first item the FIFO pops is 1
